name: Ophir Resources Co.
summary: Globally, Ophir Resources Co. specializes in the creation, manufacturing, and distribution of attire and training equipment specifically designed for mixed martial arts (MMA). Their product range includes various apparel items for both men and women, such as t-shirts, fight shorts, and caps. The company markets its offerings through its dedicated sales representatives, approved distributors, and authorized retail outlets, in addition to its online presence. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, the entity was originally known as Suffer before rebranding to Ophir Resources Co. in January 2013.
